title: Find the Array Concatenation Value
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, initialize the concatenation value to 0.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, initialize the concatenation value to 0. Continuously perform the following operation until nums has only one element: 1. If nums contains more than one element, concatenate the first and last elements of nums, convert the concatenated string back to an integer, and add this integer to the concatenation value. Then, remove the first and last elements from nums. 2. If nums contains exactly one element, add this element to the concatenation value and remove it. Return the final concatenation value.
constraints: Repeatedly take the first and last remaining values.
When two values remain at the ends, concatenate their decimal representations in first-then-last order and add that integer.
If one middle value remains, add it directly.
hints: Use one pointer at each end.
For distinct endpoints, concatenate their decimal strings in left-right order and parse the result.
When pointers meet, add the single value; then move both pointers inward.
Each operation removes exactly the endpoints represented by one loop iteration, preserving the specified process.
editorial: Each operation removes exactly the endpoints represented by one loop iteration, preserving the specified process.

tests.explanation: Concatenations 512 and 148 plus the middle thirteen total 673.
